paper_title: Stabbing Pairwise Intersecting Disks by Five Points
statement: We gave a simple linear-time algorithm to find five stabbing points for a set of pairwise intersecting disks in the plane. It remains open how to use the proofs of Danzer or Stachó [15, 5] (or any other technique) for an efficient construction of four stabbing points. It is also not known whether nine disks can be stabbed by three points or not (for eight disks, this is the case [14]). Furthermore, it would be interesting to find a simpler construction, than the one by Danzer, of ten pairwise intersecting disks that cannot be stabbed by three points.
